#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Use the pdf skill to prepend a cover page to report.pdf."""
import datetime
from io import BytesIO

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

REPORT = "report.pdf"

# 1. Build the cover page in memory: title + current date
buf = BytesIO()
c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 200, "Annual Financial Report")
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 240,
                    datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y"))
c.save()
buf.seek(0)

# 2. Prepend the cover page to the existing report
cover = PdfReader(buf).pages[0]
reader = PdfReader(REPORT)

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover)
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(REPORT, "wb") as out:
    writer.write(out)

print(f"Done: cover page prepended to {REPORT} "
      f"({len(reader.pages) + 1} total pages)")
